newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees O/N rate under 8 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy money mkt sees O/N rate under 8 pct.

text.p: Forecasts for implicit forward rates this week show Italy's money market still expects a near-term discount rate cut and an overnight rate fall under 8.0 percent, a study by Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.
Italy's discount rate was last changed in July when it was cut from 9.0 percent to 8.25 percent.
On a one month horizon the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.96 percent from an actual market average level of 8.44 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study.
One week ago, on this same timeframe, the implicit overnight rate was seen at 8.18 percent while one month ago it was forecast at 8.54 percent.
On a three-month horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen standing at 7.67 percent, lower than the 7.97 percent seen last week and the 8.42 percent forecast a month ago.

On a one-year horizon the implicit overnight rate is seen at 7.12 percent, down from the 7.64 percent seen last week. On a two year timeframe, the implicit overnight rate is seen falling to 7.60 percent from 7.93 percent forecast a week ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate, considered to be a good indicator of market confidence in Europe's Economic and Monetary Union, is seen falling to 266 basis points, from 293 bps seen last week and 332 bp forecast one month ago.
